Name: Daniel Richard
Incident Description:
Hi ,

I would like to explain what happened regarding my stolen mobile phone.

On September 10, I had planned to go to my hometown for a long leave and had already booked my bus tickets. While I was waiting at the bus stop, two people came on a bike and, within a few seconds, snatched my mobile phone from my hand and escaped.

Because of this incident, I could not even travel to my hometown. I was also unable to cancel my bus tickets, including my return ticket, which caused me a financial loss of around ₹2,000. The phone itself cost me around ₹53,000, which I had purchased after saving and working hard for it.

Immediately after the incident, I returned to my room and went to the police station with my friends on a bike to report the theft. However, I was told that an FIR could not be registered at that time.

I could not sleep that night. Around 3:00 AM, I used my laptop to check my accounts and discovered that the thieves had removed my SIM card and inserted it into another device. The device was identified as a vivo 30.

They appear to have used my SIM to access my email and log in to my PhonePe account. Around ₹1,500 was then withdrawn through transactions made at a shop.

I also noticed a ₹1 transaction sent to a person named KESAVULU. This is confusing to me because I had already sent ₹180 to the same person on September 7 for a haircut at a salon.
